title: Step 2b - Transforming Linear to Polynomial Regression: A Step-by-Step Guide

cues.en: Instructor: So Polynomial Features, and then of course, well, you know, anytime we import a class, the next step is to, of course, create an object of this class.
cues.zh: 使用 PolynomialFeatures。每次匯入類別後，下一步當然就是建立該類別的物件。

cues.en: And this object will be exactly the tool that will allow us to create this matrix of the features X1, X1 squared, X1 at the power of N.
cues.zh: 這個物件就是用來建立特徵矩陣的工具，矩陣包含 X1、X1 平方，一直到 X1 的 N 次方。

cues.en: I will precise what N we choose.
cues.zh: 我會說明 N 要選多少。

cues.en: Then we will choose several of them.
cues.zh: 接著也會試幾個不同的值。

cues.en: But there you go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: That's what we build with this Polynomial Features class.
cues.zh: 這就是 PolynomialFeatures 類別會幫我們建立的內容。

cues.en: And so, well, we're gonna call this object of this class poly underscore reg, as polynomial regressor, but it's not exactly the regressor itself.
cues.zh: 我們把這個類別的物件命名為 poly_reg，代表多項式迴歸，但它本身其實還不是迴歸器。

cues.en: Because you know, the final polynomial regressor will be the combination of this matrix of powered features and the linear regressor.
cues.zh: 因為最後的多項式迴歸器，會結合這個由特徵各次方構成的矩陣與線性迴歸器。

cues.en: And that's why we will call it actually lin reg two.
cues.zh: 所以真正的迴歸器會命名為 lin_reg_2。

cues.en: You will see, so poly reg will be created as an instance or an object of this Polynomial Features class.
cues.zh: 等等就會看到。poly_reg 是 PolynomialFeatures 類別的一個實例，也就是物件。

cues.en: So we're gonna paste that here, adding some parenthesis, and that is where we're gonna choose the N.
cues.zh: 把類別名稱貼上並加上括號，我們就在這裡設定 N。

cues.en: You know that N here is exactly chosen in this new class.
cues.zh: 這個新的類別就是設定 N 的地方。

cues.en: So first, we're gonna start with two.
cues.zh: 首先從 2 開始。

cues.en: Okay, we're gonna build a polynomial regression model resulting from the equation Y equals B0 plus B1 X1 plus B2 X1 squared, where X1 is of course the position levels
cues.zh: 我們要建立的多項式迴歸模型，其方程式為 Y = B0 + B1X1 + B2X1²；其中 X1 當然是職位等級，

cues.en: and Y is the salaries.
cues.zh: Y 則是薪資。

cues.en: All right, so let's create this.
cues.zh: 好，來建立它。

cues.en: Let's precise degree, which is the name of the parameter for that N equals 2, and then we'll try 3 and 4, okay.
cues.zh: 用參數名稱 degree 指定 N，設為 degree = 2，接著也會試 3 和 4。

cues.en: Then next step.
cues.zh: 然後進入下一步。

cues.en: Well, the next step is now to proceed to this transformation of this simple matrix of features containing only X1,
cues.zh: 下一步就是把這個只包含 X1 的簡單特徵矩陣進行轉換，

cues.en: meaning exactly this column.
cues.zh: 也就是這一欄。

cues.en: So far, this is our matrix of features of only one feature.
cues.zh: 目前的特徵矩陣只有一個特徵。

cues.en: And now we're gonna transform this matrix of a single feature into this new matrix of features containing X1 as a first feature, X1 squared as a second feature, and then that's it.
cues.zh: 現在要把這個單一特徵矩陣，轉換成新的特徵矩陣：第一個特徵是 X1，第二個是 X1²，就這兩個。

cues.en: Because so far we started with N equal 2.
cues.zh: 因為目前先設定 N = 2。

cues.en: But if we chose, for example, N equal 3, well, the matrix of features would be X1, X1 squared, and X1 at power of 3.
cues.zh: 如果選擇 N = 3，特徵矩陣就會包含 X1、X1² 與 X1³。

cues.en: All right, so that's what we're gonna do.
cues.zh: 好，這就是我們要做的事。

cues.en: And to do this, well, we're gonna take of course our fully reg object again from which we're gonna call the method Fit Transform again.
cues.zh: 做法當然是再次使用 poly_reg 物件，呼叫它的 fit_transform 方法。

cues.en: You're starting to know this method.
cues.zh: 你應該已經逐漸熟悉這個方法了。

cues.en: That's, you know, the method that usually proceed to a transformation, and here, the transformation is to turn this matrix of a single feature into this new matrix of features
cues.zh: 這個方法通常用來進行轉換；這裡是將單一特徵的矩陣，轉換為新的特徵矩陣，

cues.en: composed of X1 as the first feature and X1 squared as the second feature.
cues.zh: 其中第一個特徵是 X1，第二個特徵是 X1²。

cues.en: All right, Fit Transform, then some parenthesis.
cues.zh: 輸入 fit_transform，再加上括號。

cues.en: And then according to you now, what do we have to input here?
cues.zh: 現在你覺得這裡應該傳入什麼？

cues.en: Well, that's pretty obvious.
cues.zh: 答案很明顯。

cues.en: That's exactly the matrix of features we want to transform into this matrix of squared features, let's say, right?
cues.zh: 就是我們想轉換成這個平方特徵矩陣的原始特徵矩陣，對吧？

cues.en: So X, X, of course, that's what we wanna transform.
cues.zh: 所以是 X。當然，這就是我們要轉換的內容。

cues.en: X so far is only composed of this column.
cues.zh: 目前 X 只有這一欄。

cues.en: Okay, so Fit Transform X, and now we have our new matrix of features.
cues.zh: 好，fit_transform(X)，就得到新的特徵矩陣。

cues.en: However, this exactly returns this new matrix of features.
cues.zh: 不過，這個方法會直接回傳新的特徵矩陣。

cues.en: So now we're gonna create a new variable which will be this new matrix of features itself.
cues.zh: 所以我們要建立一個新變數，存放這個新矩陣。

cues.en: And we're gonna call it X underscore poly equals what is returned by this Fit Transform method applied to X.
cues.zh: 將它命名為 X_poly，等於對 X 呼叫 fit_transform 所回傳的結果。

cues.en: Great, so now we have exactly the matrix of features composed of the position levels and the squares of the position levels.
cues.zh: 很好，現在得到的特徵矩陣，就包含職位等級及職位等級的平方。

cues.en: Good, so now according to you, what are we going to do?
cues.zh: 好，你覺得接下來要做什麼？

cues.en: Well, as I said at the beginning, it's like now we have a new matrix of features, you know, composed of these two variables here.
cues.zh: 如同一開始所說，現在相當於有了一個新的特徵矩陣，包含這裡的兩個變數。

cues.en: And well, very simply, we just have to build a linear regression model that will integrate these features into this equation Y equals B0 plus B1X1 plus B2X1 squared.
cues.zh: 接下來很簡單，只要建立線性迴歸模型，將這些特徵放進 Y = B0 + B1X1 + B2X1² 這個方程式。

cues.en: Right? You see the idea?
cues.zh: 明白這個想法嗎？

cues.en: That's where the linear comes from.
cues.zh: 這就是「線性」的由來。

cues.en: And therefore, well, you know what to do.
cues.zh: 所以你已經知道該怎麼做了。

cues.en: You know how to create such a linear regressor.
cues.zh: 你知道如何建立這種線性迴歸器。

cues.en: But we have to create a new one which is of course different than this one because this one is already trained on this matrix of single feature X, and therefore having already learned coefficient.
cues.zh: 但必須建立新的，與原本這個不同，因為原本這個已用只有單一特徵 X 的矩陣訓練過，也已經學到了係數。

cues.en: So now we need to create a new one which we're gonna call, of course, Lin Reg.
cues.zh: 現在要建立新的迴歸器，當然同樣以 lin_reg 命名，

cues.en: And I'm adding underscore two which therefore will be a new object of this linear regression class, adding some parenthesis.
cues.zh: 再加上 _2。因此它是 LinearRegression 類別的新物件，後面加上括號。

cues.en: And well, this object will be now trained on this new matrix of features composed of the position levels at different powers.
cues.zh: 接下來會使用這個包含職位等級各次方的新特徵矩陣來訓練物件。

cues.en: And of course, then the salary because, indeed, we need the dependent variable vector to train the linear regression model and any machinery model.
cues.zh: 當然也需要薪資，因為訓練線性迴歸模型，以及任何機器學習模型，都需要依變數向量。

cues.en: All right, so the next step and final step is to of course call this new linear regressor object that we've just created from which we're gonna call the fit method
cues.zh: 好，接下來也是最後一步，就是對剛建立的新線性迴歸器物件呼叫 fit 方法，

cues.en: which we'll take as input.
cues.zh: 並傳入所需的資料。

cues.en: Of course, this new matrix of features containing the position levels at different powers, and of course, the same dependent variable vector which are the salaries.
cues.zh: 當然就是包含職位等級各次方的新特徵矩陣，以及同一個薪資依變數向量。

cues.en: All right, So let's do this.
cues.zh: 好，來做吧。

cues.en: Let's input first X poly, and then Y.
cues.zh: 先傳入 X_poly，再傳入 y。

cues.en: And there you go.
cues.zh: 這樣就完成了。

cues.en: You have your polynomial regression model.
cues.zh: 這就是你的多項式迴歸模型。

cues.en: Congratulations.
cues.zh: 恭喜。

cues.en: Now you know how to build a non-linear regression model.
cues.zh: 現在你知道如何建立非線性迴歸模型了。

cues.en: And that's what we're gonna see clearly with the next steps when visualizing the linear regression results first and the polynomial regression results.
cues.zh: 接下來先將線性迴歸結果視覺化，再看多項式迴歸結果，就會清楚看到這一點。

cues.en: Now you know how to build such a model, and you have them in the toolkit.
cues.zh: 現在你已經會建立這種模型，也把它加入工具箱了。

cues.en: So you're getting more power in machine learning, more knowledge, more skills.
cues.zh: 你在機器學習方面掌握了更多能力、知識與技巧。

cues.en: Congratulations, that's amazing.
cues.zh: 恭喜，真是太好了。

cues.en: And now I can't wait to move on to the next tutorial to show you, indeed, the different results we get with linear regression and polynomial regression.
cues.zh: 我已經迫不及待要在下一堂課，展示線性迴歸和多項式迴歸產生的不同結果。

cues.en: So I'll see you in the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 下一堂課見。

cues.en: Let's quickly run this cell in order to, you know, get the model itself.
cues.zh: 先快速執行這個儲存格，實際建立模型。

cues.en: And now whenever you're ready, let's proceed to the next tutorial for the visualizations.
cues.zh: 準備好之後，就進入下一堂課的視覺化部分。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受機器學習的樂趣吧。
